en.summary: North Korea's Sports Minister Kim Il-guk departed Pyongyang by air on the 15th and arrived in Beijing as a transit point before traveling to Japan for the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games opening on the 19th.

en.title: Election Fraud Found in Philippine Mindanao Autonomous Region; Partial Revote Ordered
en.summary: The inaugural parliamentary election for establishing a democratic autonomous government in the Islamic autonomous region of Mindanao required a revote in one municipality after pre-marked ballots were discovered. Counting in other areas is nearly complete with two parties running closely.

en.title: Ukrainian Parliament approves dismissal of Prosecutor General Kravchenko over subordinate's bribery suspicions
en.summary: Ukraine's parliament voted to remove Prosecutor General Kravchenko as requested by President Zelensky. The national anti-corruption bureau was investigating a senior official in Kravchenko's office for suspected involvement in a bribery case.

en.title: 34-year-old man indicted for dangerous driving resulting in death linked to untreated sleep apnea
en.summary: Tokyo prosecutors indicted a 34-year-old unemployed man for dangerous driving resulting in death, attributing a fatal car accident to sleep apnea syndrome. The application of this charge in a sleep apnea case is considered exceptional.

en.summary: Tokyo's standard land prices increased 7.9% year-over-year across residential, commercial, and industrial categories in 2026, marking 14 consecutive years of gains. Officials attributed the continued growth to steady economic recovery and comparable market conditions.
